stem: Voltmarkt links TVs to two categories: wall mounts and HDMI cables. During a 3-week TV promotion, wall mounts averaged 41 units a week against a baseline of 30, and HDMI cables 86 units a week against a baseline of 80. Phone chargers, which have no link to TVs, rose from 50 to 56 units a week. No mount, cable or charger was on promotion. Voltmarkt's halo adds up, over the linked categories only, each product's rise above its baseline per week times the number of promotion weeks. What is the TV promotion's halo? Give a whole number of units.
